friendlypmc-knight-competition descripti: What's up fish? I see you working your way to the top, shooting, looting, reaping and tearing. But do you actually have what it takes to run with the big dogs? Let's find out. How about you and me teamup and do a couple of runs, a little competition, see who can stack the most. You in?
friendlypmc-knight-competition successMe:
You the man!... Neah, you are right, I am the man. But you did good rookie. Listen, from now on - give me a shout when you wanna teamup and let these tourists know what's what. The boys are still sketchy about you, but you and I will make them love you!
 (You now have Knight as your friend which you can request to join you in raids. Note that he will not spawn if you have Squad Spawn enabled and is only available for PMC)
friendlypmc-knight-competition failMessa: Come on man, I have faith in you. Let's do this, let's show them what you are made of.

friendlypmc-knight-my-land description: Yo! You know what I don't like? Roachers in my house. We go on a trip and these roaches immediately move in. Be a pal and lend a hand in cleaning them out.
friendlypmc-knight-my-land failMessageTe: What are you doing man? Is the job too much for you?

friendlypmc-knight-my-land-fail: Knight must not die while the task is active (Status: KIA, Left the Action, MIA, Ran Through)
friendlypmc-knight-thieves description: Of course they robbed us, but I am not worried about the little things their dirty hands took. However, they took something important and we need it back. It's Pipe's grenade launcher. That was no random steal, they specifically must've searched for it and grabbed it. And they knew where it was. I 'asked' arround and found where it was dropped off. Go get it back and we will deal with the guy behind this later.
friendlypmc-knight-thieves successMessag: Thanks brother! We will have to talk with this gus about taking another man's property. Come back later and I will give you the details.
friendlypmc-knight-thieves failMessageTe: Come on man, don't let me down!
friendlypmc-knight-thieves-1: Look for BigPipe's grenade launcher in the Hive hookah lounge, in Streets of Tarkov.
friendlypmc-knight-payback01 description: Mister Robocop thought of upgrading and he gave himself the right to just take to our stuff—no questions, no permission. But hey, they say nobody is above the law, right? Time to put that to the test. Kollontay is the client, and our foot is about to do some thieving of its own... straight into his mouth!
friendlypmc-knight-payback01 successMess:
Justice served! Nice work man, this will go a long way with Pipe.
(You now have BigPipe as your friend which you can request to join you in raids. Note that he will not spawn if you have Squad Spawn enabled and is only available for PMC)
friendlypmc-knight-payback01 failMessage: So we are just going to let him get away with it? Come on man, let's do this!

Be my spotter and help me take out some targets. Now, I don't like small fries, if you run with me, we go for the big game. So, shall we?

friendlypmc-knight-afavor description: BirdEye here. You can really handle yourself outhere, I like running with you. Listen, I want you to help with something. That Shturman guy needs a real lesson in manners. We where in the Woods approaching the sawmill when he started acting all crazy about how this is his turf and how I should just change my name to Bullseye Bob because I can't hit anything. Well, I think we should show him who is the real One-Tapper. Help me deliver a lesson to him he will never forget and you are in. What do you say?
friendlypmc-knight-afavor successMessage:
Lovely, just lovely! That will teach him to mess with us.
